questions.concept: Ready queue as selection pool when CPU is idle
questions.question: When the CPU becomes idle, from which queue does the operating system select the next process to execute?
questions.explanation: The CPU scheduler picks the next process from the ready queue, which holds processes waiting to be executed by the CPU.

questions.concept: Link tag for external style sheets
questions.question: Which HTML tag is used to link an external style sheet to a page?
questions.explanation: The <link> tag connects external resources such as style sheets; <a> creates hyperlinks on the page.

questions.question: ISCII retains all 128 ASCII codes. In which code range are the additional aksharas of Indian languages assigned?
questions.explanation: ISCII keeps codes 0-127 for ASCII and assigns the additional Indian language aksharas in the upper region 160-255.

questions.question: A citizen pays house tax and the electricity bill on a government portal. Which e-commerce type does this represent?
questions.explanation: Consumers paying government bodies (income tax, house tax, electricity payments) is Consumer-to-Government (C2G); G2C is the reverse direction.

questions.question: How is a single channel shared by multiple signals in a computer network?
questions.explanation: Multiplexing lets multiple signals share one channel; modulation only changes a carrier signal.

questions.question: In the puzzle project, when the player clicks a cell that has no bomb, what does the cell reveal?

options.A: The time remaining in the game
options.B: The total number of bombs on the board
options.C: A number giving the count of neighbouring bombs

questions.explanation: A bomb-free cell reveals a number indicating how many neighbouring cells contain bombs.

questions.concept: NFA construction and space compared to DFA
questions.question: Compared with a DFA, an NFA is described as:

options.A: Harder to construct and requiring more space
options.B: Easier to construct but requiring more space
options.C: Easier to construct and requiring less space
options.D: Harder to construct but requiring less space

questions.explanation: NFA requires less space and is easier to construct; DFA requires more space and is more difficult to construct.

questions.question: A text file contains exactly 12 ASCII characters and no newline. What does f.tell() return right after f.read() reads the entire file?
questions.explanation: tell() gives the byte position from the beginning of the file. After all 12 bytes have been read, the position is 12.

questions.concept: Gorilla testing also called frustrating testing
questions.question: Which testing type is also known as Frustrating Testing?
questions.explanation: Gorilla testing, the repetitive manual testing of a module to test its robustness, is also called Frustrating Testing.

questions.question: Which contiguous memory allocation algorithm searches for the largest free partition for a process?
questions.explanation: Worst Fit picks the largest hole. Best Fit picks the smallest hole that fits, and First Fit picks the first hole large enough.

questions.question: A column Marks holds the values 45, 72, 38, 90 and 61. What does SELECT MAX(Marks) - MIN(Marks) FROM RESULT; return?
questions.explanation: MAX returns 90 and MIN returns 38, so the difference is 52. 306 is the SUM of the column.

questions.concept: Instance of abstract class cannot be created
questions.question: An instance (object) of which kind of class cannot be created?
questions.explanation: An abstract class is meant only to be inherited from, so objects of it cannot be instantiated directly.

questions.question: Unauthorized activity on a computer network, such as unauthorized use of its resources, is termed:
questions.explanation: Network intrusion is any unauthorized activity on a computer network, including unauthorized use of network resources or threats to data.

questions.concept: Shorter clock cycles mean faster processor
questions.question: Processor speed is determined by its clock cycles. A faster processor has:
questions.explanation: Shorter clock cycles mean more cycles per second, so the processor is faster.

questions.question: What average data rate does 5G IoT offer?
questions.explanation: 5G IoT gives 100+ Mbps average data rates; 20 Gbps is its peak rate, and 1 Mbps is the reduced throughput of Cat-0.

questions.question: How is data passed along the shared medium in a bus topology?

options.A: Only through a central hub to the destination
options.B: In both directions, and any node on the bus can receive it
options.C: Over a dedicated link between every pair of nodes
options.D: In one direction only around a closed loop

questions.explanation: In bus topology, data travels along the bus in both directions and every connected node can receive it.

questions.concept: Flash memory later form of EEPROM
questions.question: Flash memory, which can be erased electrically, is a later form of which memory?
questions.explanation: Flash memory evolved from EEPROM and, like it, is erased electrically. EPROM uses UV rays.

questions.concept: Comparisons in deque palindrome check of RADAR
questions.question: A deque based palindrome check removes one character from the front and one from the rear and compares them, repeating while more than one character remains. How many such comparisons are made for the string RADAR?
questions.explanation: Pairs compared are R/R and A/A; only D remains, so the loop stops after 2 comparisons.

questions.concept: Successive read(n) calls continue from current position
questions.question:
A text file contains exactly Hello World. What is printed by the following code?
f = open('a.txt', 'r')
f.read(3)
print(f.read(4))
f.close()
questions.explanation: The first read(3) consumes 'Hel' and moves the file position to 3. The next read(4) returns the following four characters, 'lo W'.

questions.concept: Increasing order of power of the four primary machines
questions.question: Which sequence lists the four primary machines of TOC in increasing order of computational power?

options.A: Finite automata, linear bounded automata, pushdown automata, Turing machine
options.B: Finite automata, pushdown automata, linear bounded automata, Turing machine
options.C: Finite automata, pushdown automata, Turing machine, linear bounded automata
options.D: Pushdown automata, finite automata, linear bounded automata, Turing machine

questions.explanation: FA recognize regular languages, PDA context-free, LBA context-sensitive and the Turing machine is the most powerful, matching Types 3, 2, 1 and 0.

questions.concept: Data mining technique uses machine learning
questions.question: Which antivirus identification method uses machine learning to classify the behaviour of a file as benign or malicious?
questions.explanation: Data mining techniques classify file behaviour as benign or malicious using machine learning.

questions.question: Which set correctly lists the roles in MQTT communication?
questions.explanation: MQTT works with a Publisher, a Subscriber and a Broker.

questions.question: Which primitive data structure holds the memory address of another variable?
questions.explanation: A pointer contains the memory address of data and is used with arrays and strings for efficient access.

questions.concept: Valid query filtering groups by aggregate
questions.question: An EMPLOYEE table has columns EmpID and Dept. Which query correctly lists departments having more than 5 employees?

options.A: SELECT Dept FROM EMPLOYEE GROUP BY Dept WHERE COUNT(*) > 5;
options.B: SELECT Dept FROM EMPLOYEE WHERE COUNT(*) > 5 GROUP BY Dept;
options.C: SELECT Dept FROM EMPLOYEE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY Dept;
options.D: SELECT Dept FROM EMPLOYEE GROUP BY Dept HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

questions.explanation: WHERE cannot be used with aggregate functions and HAVING needs GROUP BY, so the condition on COUNT(*) belongs in HAVING after GROUP BY.
